```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request number to review'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install requests

      - name: Validate PR number
        if: ${{ !inputs.pr_number }}
        run: |
          echo "❌ Error: PR number is required."
          exit 1

      - name: Fetch changed files
        id: fetch
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ inputs.pr_number }};
            const { data: files } = await github.rest.pulls.listFiles({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: prNumber,
              per_page: 100
            });
            const connectorPattern = /^airbyte-integrations\/connectors\/[^/]+\/.*/;
            const hasConnector = files.some(f => connectorPattern.test(f.filename));
            core.setOutput('has_connector', hasConnector);

      - name: Post started comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ inputs.pr_number }};
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: '🧠 AI Docs Review started.'
            });

      - name: Run Devin if connector changes
        if: steps.fetch.outputs.has_connector == 'true'
        uses: airbytehq/devin-action@v1
        with:
          playbook: '!connectordocs_pr_review'
          pr_number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}

      - name: Post skipped comment
        if: steps.fetch.outputs.has_connector == 'false'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ inputs.pr_number }};
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: '⚠️ No connector changes detected. Skipping AI Docs Review.'
            });

      - name: Post error comment
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ inputs.pr_number }};
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: '❌ AI Docs Review failed due to an error.'
            });
```
